s.note: breakfast in the transit dispatch room
s.how: Beat 200g cream cheese with 50g caster sugar, 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp lemon zest. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into 8 squares, spoon filling into the middle and fold in the corners. Bake at 200C for 16 minutes, cool 5 minutes and drizzle with 60g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice.
Warm 8 jam doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes. Roll each straight away in 80g caster sugar so it sticks, and serve on a plate in the middle of the table like the transit office tray.

m.how: Split 4 long rolls and spread each with mayonnaise, using 100g in total. Layer with 400g sliced turkey, 8 slices Swiss cheese, shredded iceberg lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes. Season, close, wrap tightly in paper and cut in half.

w.how: Rub 225g butter and 225g cream cheese into 280g flour and chill 1 hour. Roll into circles, spread with apricot jam, walnuts and cinnamon sugar, cut into wedges and roll up. Bake at 180C for 22 minutes.

d.note: Garber's long day on the phone
d.how: Brew 1 litre of drip coffee with 60g ground coffee. Pour into four paper cups, add milk, about 200ml in total, and sugar to taste, and snap on the lids.
